intervals.note: Spans from CERN's approval of the UA1 proposal to the experiment's completion date. Operating interval; the terminal event is its end.

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: Spans from CERN's approval of the UA1 proposal to the experiment's completion date. Terminal event: the end of the operating interval above.

name: UA1 Collaboration
notes: No official-roster institution/member/country count for the UA1 Collaboration was located among the sources fetched this session (home.cern, the CERN archives guide and the INSPIRE experiment record do not give one); collaboration.membership is therefore omitted rather than guessed.

summary.plain: The international team of physicists and engineers, led by Carlo Rubbia, who built and ran the UA1 detector at CERN and co-discovered the W and Z bosons.
summary.technical: Formed around the 1978 UA1 proposal to CERN; approved by CERN on 29 June 1978. No collaboration-size figure (institution/member count) was sourced in this session.
